negative_results: R11: native QueryResultCache serves stale data after INSERT when explicitly enabled. This is documented contract, not engine correctness bug; must define staleness budget or bypass cache.

R13: compact regex vs literal 200-item alternation changes the matcher source path but does not yield proven latency/CPU win on sparse, mixed-by-ID fixture; 1.34% wall and0.85% CPU differences are below1.76% A/A drift. Query tracker memory differs (~1MB), not generalized.

R13: Original report.json uses ACCEPT_FOR_NEXT_GATE to mean gates pass, not scientific speedup; immutable evidence says NO_EFFECT. Script fixed for future runs; do not rerun same fixture just to change label.
